Feature: Report Unused Vehicle Reason - Flag Disabled
Title: Option disabled; unused_vehicles not present despite unassigned tasks
Description: When report_unused_vehicle_reason is false or omitted, unused_vehicles must not be populated in the response, even if unassigned tasks exist.
Expected Result: 200; result.code==0; unused_vehicles not present in response

Feature: Report Unused Vehicle Reason - Full Assignment
Title: Option enabled, all tasks assigned; unused_vehicles not present
Description: When all jobs are successfully assigned and no vehicles are idle, unused_vehicles must not be populated even with the flag enabled.
Expected Result: 200; result.code==0; unused_vehicles not present (no unassigned tasks)

Feature: Report Unused Vehicle Reason - Time Window Constraint
Title: Idle vehicle blocked by time window; reason populated
Description: An idle vehicle whose time window cannot overlap with any unassigned task is reported with a time_window reason.
Details: Locations: 3; Vehicles: 1; Jobs: 2; Features: options.report_unused_vehicle_reason, vehicles.time_window
Expected Result: 200; result.code==0; V1 in unused_vehicles with time_window reason; feasible_unassigned: false
Validation: invalid: /jobs/1 must NOT have additional properties

Feature: Report Unused Vehicle Reason - Capacity Block
Title: Idle vehicle capacity too small; reason populated
Description: An idle vehicle whose capacity cannot accommodate any remaining unassigned task is reported with a capacity reason.
Details: Locations: 3; Vehicles: 1; Jobs: 2; Features: options.report_unused_vehicle_reason, vehicles.capacity
Expected Result: 200; result.code==0; J1 and J2 unassigned; V1 in unused_vehicles with capacity reason; feasible_unassigned: false

Feature: Report Unused Vehicle Reason - Invalid Type
Title: Non-boolean report_unused_vehicle_reason value; rejected
Description: When report_unused_vehicle_reason is a string instead of boolean, the request fails validation at submit.
Expected Result: 400; input validation failed; error indicates report_unused_vehicle_reason must be boolean

Feature: Report Unused Vehicle Reason - Mixed Vehicle Capability
Title: Two vehicles: one incapable, one assigned; unused vehicle reported
Description: With two vehicles where one has insufficient capacity and one serves all jobs, the incapable vehicle is reported in unused_vehicles.
Details: Locations: 11; Vehicles: 2; Jobs: 10; Features: options.report_unused_vehicle_reason, vehicles.capacity
Expected Result: 200; result.code==0; all jobs assigned to V1; V2 in unused_vehicles with capacity reason; feasible_unassigned: false

Feature: Report Unused Vehicle Reason - Feasible Idle Vehicle
Title: Idle vehicle feasible for unassigned task; reasons empty
Description: An idle vehicle capable of serving unassigned tasks is reported with empty reasons array and feasible_unassigned: true.
Details: Locations: 11; Vehicles: 2; Jobs: 10; Features: options.report_unused_vehicle_reason, vehicles.capacity
Expected Result: 200; result.code==0; V1 fully assigned; V2 in unused_vehicles with empty reasons array; feasible_unassigned: true

Feature: Report Unused Vehicle Reason - All Vehicles Used
Title: All vehicles used but unassigned tasks exist; unused_vehicles empty array
Description: When every vehicle is assigned at least one task but some tasks remain unassigned, unused_vehicles is an empty array.
Expected Result: 200; result.code==0; V1 and V2 both used; several jobs unassigned; unused_vehicles: [] (empty array present)

Feature: Report Unused Vehicle Reason - Multiple Constraints
Title: Idle vehicle blocked by multiple constraints; all reasons present
Description: An idle vehicle blocked from serving unassigned tasks by multiple constraints (e.g. capacity and skills) reports all blocking reasons, deduplicated.
Details: Locations: 11; Vehicles: 1; Jobs: 10; Features: options.report_unused_vehicle_reason, vehicles.capacity, vehicles.skills, jobs.skills
Expected Result: 200; result.code==0; V1 in unused_vehicles with capacity and skills reasons both present, deduplicated; feasible_unassigned: false

Feature: Report Unused Vehicle Reason - Shipment Unit Unassigned
Title: Shipment pickup-delivery pair unassigned due to capacity; reason aggregated
Description: An atomic shipment (pickup + delivery pair) unassigned on a vehicle due to capacity yields one aggregated capacity reason for the whole shipment, not separate reasons per step.
Details: Locations: 11; Vehicles: 1; Jobs: 8; Features: options.report_unused_vehicle_reason, jobs.pickup, jobs.delivery
Expected Result: 200; result.code==0; pickup-delivery jobs assigned; J3-J8 unassigned due to capacity; V1 in unused_vehicles with capacity reason

Feature: Report Unused Vehicle Reason - Large Fleet Underutilized
Title: Five-vehicle fleet with 25 jobs; multiple idle vehicles reported
Description: In a large scenario with unassigned tasks, multiple idle vehicles are reported in unused_vehicles with their respective blocking reasons.
Details: Locations: 26; Vehicles: 5; Jobs: 25; Features: options.report_unused_vehicle_reason, vehicles.capacity
Expected Result: 200; result.code==0; V1-V3 assigned jobs; V4 and/or V5 in unused_vehicles with capacity reasons; feasible_unassigned: false

Feature: Report Unused Vehicle Reason - Zone Constraint Blocks
Title: Idle vehicle zone incompatible with unassigned tasks; zone reason present
Description: An idle vehicle whose zone restriction prevents it from reaching any unassigned task is reported with a zone-related reason.
Details: Locations: 26; Vehicles: 5; Jobs: 25; Features: options.report_unused_vehicle_reason, vehicles.start_depot_ids, jobs.depot_ids
Expected Result: 200; result.code==0; some vehicles assigned their zone tasks; incompatible idle vehicles in unused_vehicles with depot/zone reason; feasible_unassigned: false

Feature: Report Unused Vehicle Reason - Complex Partial Assignment
Title: Mixed large scenario; vehicles assigned with varying idle patterns
Description: A complex five-vehicle, 25-job scenario where demand is partially met, some vehicles are assigned, and others remain idle due to multiple factors. Unused vehicles are accurately reported with their blocking reasons.
Details: Locations: 26; Vehicles: 5; Jobs: 25; Features: options.report_unused_vehicle_reason, vehicles.capacity, vehicles.time_window, vehicles.skills, jobs.time_window, jobs.skills
Expected Result: 200; result.code==0; V1-V4 assigned tasks; some jobs unassigned; unused_vehicles populated with vehicles blocked by capacity/time_window/skills constraints; feasible_unassigned reflects capability of idle vehicles
Validation: invalid: /jobs/8 must NOT have additional properties
